connectIntro: Connect your Google Calendar and Simon Says shows the association's upcoming meetings on the Meetings tab, under From the calendar, and fills in the meeting's name and who is invited when you start. Simon Says only reads, and only the calendar the association has chosen.
connected: Your Google Calendar is connected (read only).
disconnectText: We delete our copy of the access, and upcoming meetings are no longer shown. To remove the access completely, do it in your Google account.

result.nej: The calendar was not connected. The calendar box was not ticked, or you cancelled.
result.fel: The calendar could not be connected. Try again in a little while.
result.konto: You chose a different Google account than the one you are signed in with. Nothing was connected.
result.fran: The calendar is disconnected. Our copy of the access is deleted.

orgIntro: Choose the calendar that holds the association's meetings, for example a shared calendar. Members who have connected their own calendar and can see this one see the upcoming meetings on the Meetings tab, under From the calendar.
orgConnectFirst: Connect your calendar first, then you can choose among your calendars.
orgUnavailable: We could not read your calendars right now. Try again in a little while.
orgNoShared: You have no shared calendars. Create a calendar for the association in Google Calendar and share it with the members, then choose it here. Your own main calendar can't be chosen.
filterHint: Optional, for example “meeting”. Empty: every event in the calendar.
nothingUpcoming: No upcoming meetings in the calendar.
connectHint: Connect your calendar to see the association's upcoming meetings here.
unavailable: The calendar could not be read with your Google account.
